reason: The row holds, on value and on the rules. (1) An ERROR has no display, so the 09:00Z exp89t read rule ('+' >= 0.960 -> new V_pub; 0.959 only with an attributable UP; else no change) leaves the running champion exp87a 56640366 (0.959, COMPLETE 28 Sep 21:43Z) as V_pub. П3 {exp87a 56640366, #37 56563521} stays, and DIS on the CI base stays unread. (2) There is no private-side risk. exp87a is already COMPLETE, so its private score came from the same hidden-test run. An exp89t ERROR, even a timeout, is not a CI runtime warning for V_pub, so no CI-risk flag is needed. (3) No re-submit is correct, and the timing edge is tighter than the row says. The row's 11:07Z is only the lower-bound edge (L >= 8.88 h from exp75). At typical CI L of 9.28-9.48 h, a re-submit has to go by about 10:17-10:28Z to read by about 19:45Z, before the 20:00Z (23:00 MSK) tick. At 10:18:41Z, 56669888 was still PENDING, so every ERROR from now on is too late. (4) Possible conflict checked: R13-A1 (5) (CONTEXT l.2824-2826) and the W2 rule (l.3160) rank an 'unchanged resubmit of an ERRORed finals-relevant file (ERROR < 10 h)' above an empty slot. That rule does not bind here, for three reasons: the re-submit cannot read before the tick at typical L; slot 2 is held by the user until 12:00Z (08:28Z entry); and the expected gain is about 0, since exp89r 0.957 put DIS at about 0 (09:19Z). The row does not cite this, so a reader could take it as breaking R13-A1 (5). It does not reopen a closed line, and it needs no build or dummy.
